piezas.titulo: Listen: Tone, politeness and implicit meaning
texto: Listening comprehension of dialogues with a heavy pragmatic load, diplomatic subtlety or veiled irony: train yourself to detect softening particles («นะ», «จ๊ะ», «ซิ»), deliberate pauses and deliberate tonal rises that alter the literal value of a reply. When you hear «น้ำเสียงทำให้ประโยคเดียวกันมีนัยต่างกัน», pay attention to the gap between courteous vocabulary and the emotional stance underneath.
